title: Port a Databricks notebook to Fabric
objectives: Replace Databricks table names with Fabric lakehouse names
Swap Databricks-only functions for standard SQL
Rewrite INSERT OVERWRITE for a Fabric Warehouse

exercises.prompt: Port the notebook's query: each customer's net amount (amount minus discount, with no discount counting as 0) from the silver schema's orders, as customer_id and net, in customer_id order.
hints: spark_catalog.default.orders is Databricks' name. Here the table is silver.orders.
nvl() is Databricks SQL; coalesce(discount, 0) works on every platform.

exercises.prompt: Port the notebook's write for a Fabric Warehouse, which has no INSERT OVERWRITE: replace everything in silver.customer_net with the query's rows, naming the columns. End with SELECT customer_id, net FROM silver.customer_net ORDER BY customer_id.
hints: INSERT OVERWRITE replaces the table's rows. Do the same with two statements.
DELETE FROM silver.customer_net; then INSERT INTO silver.customer_net (customer_id, net) SELECT ... with the ported query.
